WITH prices AS (
    SELECT
        0.12::numeric AS price_active_energy,     -- €/kWh
        0.03::numeric AS price_reactive_energy,   -- €/kVArh
        5.00::numeric AS price_peak_active,       -- €/kW
        3.00::numeric AS price_peak_reactive      -- €/kVAr
),

-- 1) DAILY ENERGY DELTAS (per quantity)
energy_daily AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('month', d.timestamputc) AS month,
        DATE_TRUNC('day',   d.timestamputc) AS day,
        q.quantityname,
        MAX(d.value) - MIN(d.value) AS delta
    FROM datalog2 d
    JOIN quantities q ON q.quantityid = d.quantityid
    WHERE 
        q.quantityname IN ('Active_Energy_Delivered','Reactive_Energy_Delivered')
        AND $__timeFilter(d.timestamputc)
    GROUP BY 1,2,3
),

-- 2) MONTHLY ENERGY COSTS
monthly_energy AS (
    SELECT
        month,
        SUM(
            CASE WHEN quantityname = 'Active_Energy_Delivered'
                 THEN GREATEST(delta,0) * (SELECT price_active_energy FROM prices)
                 ELSE 0 END
        ) AS active_energy_cost,

        SUM(
            CASE WHEN quantityname = 'Reactive_Energy_Delivered'
                 THEN GREATEST(delta,0) * (SELECT price_reactive_energy FROM prices)
                 ELSE 0 END
        ) AS reactive_energy_cost
    FROM energy_daily
    GROUP BY month
),

-- 3) PER-DEVICE MONTHLY MAX PEAK DEMAND
per_device_peak AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('month', d.timestamputc) AS month,
        s.devicename,
        MAX(d.value) FILTER (WHERE q.quantityname = 'Peak_Active_Demand')   AS peak_active,
        MAX(d.value) FILTER (WHERE q.quantityname = 'Peak_Reactive_Demand') AS peak_reactive
    FROM datalog2 d
    JOIN quantities q ON q.quantityid = d.quantityid
    JOIN sources    s ON s.sourceid   = d.sourceid
    WHERE 
        q.quantityname IN ('Peak_Active_Demand','Peak_Reactive_Demand')
        AND $__timeFilter(d.timestamputc)
    GROUP BY 1,2
),

-- 4) MONTHLY PEAK DEMAND COSTS
monthly_demand AS (
    SELECT
        month,
        SUM(COALESCE(peak_active,  0)) * (SELECT price_peak_active   FROM prices) AS peak_active_cost,
        SUM(COALESCE(peak_reactive,0)) * (SELECT price_peak_reactive FROM prices) AS peak_reactive_cost
    FROM per_device_peak
    GROUP BY month
)

-- 5) FINAL RESULTS WITH RENAMED LABELS
SELECT
    COALESCE(e.month, d.month) AS month,

    ROUND(e.active_energy_cost::numeric,   2) AS "Active Energy Cost",
    ROUND(e.reactive_energy_cost::numeric, 2) AS "Reactive Energy Cost",

    ROUND(d.peak_active_cost::numeric,     2) AS "Peak Active Demand Cost",
    ROUND(d.peak_reactive_cost::numeric,   2) AS "Peak Reactive Demand Cost",

    ROUND((
        COALESCE(e.active_energy_cost,0) +
        COALESCE(e.reactive_energy_cost,0) +
        COALESCE(d.peak_active_cost,0) +
        COALESCE(d.peak_reactive_cost,0)
    )::numeric, 2) AS "Total Monthly Cost"

FROM monthly_energy e
FULL JOIN monthly_demand d ON e.month = d.month
ORDER BY month;

WITH energy_data AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('day', d.timestamputc) AS day,
        s.devicename AS consumer,
        q.quantityname,
        MAX(d.value) - MIN(d.value) AS delta_value
    FROM datalog2 d
    JOIN sources s      ON d.sourceid   = s.sourceid
    JOIN quantities q   ON d.quantityid = q.quantityid
    WHERE
        q.quantityname IN ('Active_Energy_Delivered', 'Reactive_Energy_Delivered')
        AND d.timestamputc BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
    GROUP BY
        DATE_TRUNC('day', d.timestamputc),
        s.devicename,
        q.quantityname
),
daily_device_cost AS (
    SELECT
        day,
        consumer,
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN quantityname = 'Active_Energy_Delivered'            THEN delta_value * 0.12
                WHEN quantityname = 'Reactive_Energy_Delivered'    THEN delta_value * 0.03
            END
        ) AS cost
    FROM energy_data
    GROUP BY day, consumer
),
daily_totals AS (
    SELECT
        day,
        ROUND(SUM(cost)::numeric, 4) AS daily_total
    FROM daily_device_cost
    GROUP BY day
)
SELECT
    day AS "Day",
    daily_total AS "Daily Cost (€)",
    SUM(daily_total) OVER (
        ORDER BY day
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS "Cumulative Cost (€)"
FROM daily_totals
ORDER BY day;

WITH prices AS (
    SELECT
        0.12::numeric AS price_active_energy,     -- €/kWh
        0.03::numeric AS price_reactive_energy,   -- €/kVArh
        5.00::numeric AS price_peak_active,       -- €/kW
        3.00::numeric AS price_peak_reactive      -- €/kVAr
),

/* ---------------------------------------------------------
   1) DAILY ENERGY DELTA (Active + Reactive)
   --------------------------------------------------------- */
energy_daily AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('month', d.timestamputc) AS month,
        DATE_TRUNC('day',   d.timestamputc) AS day,
        q.quantityname,
        MAX(d.value) - MIN(d.value) AS delta
    FROM datalog2 d
    JOIN quantities q ON q.quantityid = d.quantityid
    WHERE 
        q.quantityname IN ('Active_Energy_Delivered', 'Reactive_Energy_Delivered')
        AND d.timestamputc BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-02-26'
    GROUP BY 1,2,3
),

/* ---------------------------------------------------------
   2) MONTHLY ENERGY COST
   --------------------------------------------------------- */
monthly_energy AS (
    SELECT
        month,
        SUM(
            CASE WHEN quantityname = 'Active_Energy_Delivered'
                 THEN GREATEST(delta,0) * (SELECT price_active_energy FROM prices)
                 ELSE 0 END
        ) AS active_energy_cost,

        SUM(
            CASE WHEN quantityname = 'Reactive_Energy_Delivered'
                 THEN GREATEST(delta,0) * (SELECT price_reactive_energy FROM prices)
                 ELSE 0 END
        ) AS reactive_energy_cost

    FROM energy_daily
    GROUP BY month
),

/* ---------------------------------------------------------
   3) PER-DEVICE MONTHLY MAX DEMAND
   --------------------------------------------------------- */
per_device_peak AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('month', d.timestamputc) AS month,
        s.devicename,
        MAX(d.value) FILTER (WHERE q.quantityname = 'Peak_Active_Demand')   AS peak_active,
        MAX(d.value) FILTER (WHERE q.quantityname = 'Peak_Reactive_Demand') AS peak_reactive
    FROM datalog2 d
    JOIN quantities q ON q.quantityid = d.quantityid
    JOIN sources    s ON s.sourceid   = d.sourceid
    WHERE 
        q.quantityname IN ('Peak_Active_Demand','Peak_Reactive_Demand')
        AND d.timestamputc BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-02-26'
    GROUP BY 1,2
),

/* ---------------------------------------------------------
   4) MONTHLY PEAK DEMAND COST (SUM DEVICES × TARIFF)
   --------------------------------------------------------- */
monthly_demand AS (
    SELECT
        month,
        SUM(COALESCE(peak_active, 0)) * (SELECT price_peak_active   FROM prices) AS peak_active_cost,
        SUM(COALESCE(peak_reactive,0)) * (SELECT price_peak_reactive FROM prices) AS peak_reactive_cost
    FROM per_device_peak
    GROUP BY month
)

/* ---------------------------------------------------------
   5) FINAL MONTHLY BILLING
   --------------------------------------------------------- */
SELECT
    COALESCE(e.month, d.month) AS "Month",

    ROUND(e.active_energy_cost::numeric,   4) AS "Active Energy Cost",
    ROUND(e.reactive_energy_cost::numeric, 4) AS "Reactive Energy Cost",

    ROUND(d.peak_active_cost::numeric,     4) AS "Peak Active Demand Cost",
    ROUND(d.peak_reactive_cost::numeric,   4) AS "Peak Reactive Demand Cost",

    ROUND((
        COALESCE(e.active_energy_cost,0) +
        COALESCE(e.reactive_energy_cost,0) +
        COALESCE(d.peak_active_cost,0) +
        COALESCE(d.peak_reactive_cost,0)
    )::numeric, 4) AS "Monthly Total (€)",

    SUM((
        COALESCE(e.active_energy_cost,0) +
        COALESCE(e.reactive_energy_cost,0) +
        COALESCE(d.peak_active_cost,0) +
        COALESCE(d.peak_reactive_cost,0)
    )) OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(e.month, d.month)) AS "Cumulative Billing"

FROM monthly_energy e
FULL JOIN monthly_demand d ON e.month = d.month
ORDER BY "Month";

WITH per_device_monthly_max AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', d.timestamputc) AS month,
    s.devicename,

    -- Max Peak Active Demand per device
    MAX(d.value) FILTER (WHERE q.quantityname = 'Peak_Active_Demand') AS peak_active,

    -- Max Peak Reactive Demand per device
    MAX(d.value) FILTER (WHERE q.quantityname = 'Peak_Reactive_Demand') AS peak_reactive

  FROM datalog2 d
  JOIN quantities q ON d.quantityid = q.quantityid
  JOIN sources s    ON d.sourceid   = s.sourceid

  WHERE
    q.quantityname IN ('Peak_Active_Demand', 'Peak_Reactive_Demand')
    AND $__timeFilter(d.timestamputc)

  GROUP BY 1, 2
)

SELECT
  month AS "Month",
  SUM(peak_active)   AS "Peak Active Demand",
  SUM(peak_reactive) AS "Peak Reactive Demand"
FROM per_device_monthly_max
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month;

WITH prices AS (
    SELECT
        0.12::numeric AS price_active_energy,     -- €/kWh
        0.03::numeric AS price_reactive_energy,   -- €/kVArh
        5.00::numeric AS price_peak_active,       -- €/kW
        3.00::numeric AS price_peak_reactive      -- €/kVAr
),

/* ---------------------------------------------------------
   1) DAILY ENERGY DELTA PER DEVICE
   --------------------------------------------------------- */
energy_daily AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('month', d.timestamputc) AS month,
        DATE_TRUNC('day',   d.timestamputc) AS day,
        s.devicename,
        q.quantityname,
        MAX(d.value) - MIN(d.value) AS delta
    FROM datalog2 d
    JOIN quantities q ON q.quantityid = d.quantityid
    JOIN sources    s ON s.sourceid   = d.sourceid
    WHERE 
        q.quantityname IN ('Active_Energy_Delivered','Reactive_Energy_Delivered')
        AND d.timestamputc BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-02-24'
    GROUP BY 1,2,3,4
),

/* ---------------------------------------------------------
   2) MONTHLY ENERGY COST PER DEVICE
   --------------------------------------------------------- */
monthly_energy AS (
    SELECT
        month,
        devicename,
        SUM(
            CASE WHEN quantityname = 'Active_Energy_Delivered'
                 THEN GREATEST(delta,0) * (SELECT price_active_energy FROM prices)
                 ELSE 0 END
        ) AS active_energy_cost,

        SUM(
            CASE WHEN quantityname = 'Reactive_Energy_Delivered'
                 THEN GREATEST(delta,0) * (SELECT price_reactive_energy FROM prices)
                 ELSE 0 END
        ) AS reactive_energy_cost
    FROM energy_daily
    GROUP BY month, devicename
),

/* ---------------------------------------------------------
   3) PER-DEVICE MONTHLY MAX PEAK DEMAND
   --------------------------------------------------------- */
per_device_peak AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('month', d.timestamputc) AS month,
        s.devicename,
        MAX(d.value) FILTER (WHERE q.quantityname = 'Peak_Active_Demand')   AS peak_active,
        MAX(d.value) FILTER (WHERE q.quantityname = 'Peak_Reactive_Demand') AS peak_reactive
    FROM datalog2 d
    JOIN quantities q ON q.quantityid = d.quantityid
    JOIN sources    s ON s.sourceid   = d.sourceid
    WHERE 
        q.quantityname IN ('Peak_Active_Demand','Peak_Reactive_Demand')
        AND d.timestamputc BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-02-24'
    GROUP BY 1,2
),

/* ---------------------------------------------------------
   4) DEMAND COST PER DEVICE
   --------------------------------------------------------- */
monthly_demand AS (
    SELECT
        month,
        devicename,
        (COALESCE(peak_active,0)  * (SELECT price_peak_active   FROM prices)) AS peak_active_cost,
        (COALESCE(peak_reactive,0) * (SELECT price_peak_reactive FROM prices)) AS peak_reactive_cost
    FROM per_device_peak
)

/* ---------------------------------------------------------
   5) FINAL PER-DEVICE BILLING
   --------------------------------------------------------- */
SELECT
    COALESCE(e.month, d.month) AS "Month",
    COALESCE(e.devicename, d.devicename) AS "Device",

    ROUND(e.active_energy_cost::numeric,   4) AS "Active Energy Cost (€)",
    ROUND(e.reactive_energy_cost::numeric, 4) AS "Reactive Energy Cost (€)",
    ROUND(d.peak_active_cost::numeric,     4) AS "Peak Active Demand Cost (€)",
    ROUND(d.peak_reactive_cost::numeric,   4) AS "Peak Reactive Demand Cost (€)",

    ROUND((
        COALESCE(e.active_energy_cost,0) +
        COALESCE(e.reactive_energy_cost,0) +
        COALESCE(d.peak_active_cost,0) +
        COALESCE(d.peak_reactive_cost,0)
    )::numeric, 4) AS "Total Device Cost (€)"

FROM monthly_energy e
FULL JOIN monthly_demand d
      ON e.month = d.month AND e.devicename = d.devicename
ORDER BY "Month", "Device";

WITH daily_costs AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('day', d.timestamputc) AS day,
        s.devicename AS consumer,
        ((MAX(d.value) - MIN(d.value)) * 0.12) AS cost
    FROM datalog2 d
    JOIN sources s      ON d.sourceid   = s.sourceid
    JOIN quantities q   ON d.quantityid = q.quantityid
    WHERE
        q.quantityname = 'Active_Energy_Delivered'
        AND d.timestamputc BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
    GROUP BY
        DATE_TRUNC('day', d.timestamputc),
        s.devicename
)

-- Combine all 3 granularities:
SELECT
    day AS period,
    'Daily' AS type,
    ROUND(SUM(cost)::numeric, 4) AS Active_Energy_Delivered
FROM daily_costs
GROUP BY day

UNION ALL

SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('week', day) AS period,
    'Weekly' AS type,
    ROUND(SUM(cost)::numeric, 4) AS total_cost
FROM daily_costs
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('week', day)

UNION ALL

SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', day) AS period,
    'Monthly' AS type,
    ROUND(SUM(cost)::numeric, 4) AS total_cost
FROM daily_costs
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', day)

ORDER BY period, type;

WITH daily_costs AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('day', d.timestamputc) AS day,
        s.devicename AS consumer,
        ((MAX(d.value) - MIN(d.value)) * 0.12) AS cost
    FROM datalog2 d
    JOIN sources s      ON d.sourceid   = s.sourceid
    JOIN quantities q   ON d.quantityid = q.quantityid
    WHERE
        q.quantityname = 'Reactive_Energy_Delivered'
        AND d.timestamputc BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
    GROUP BY
        DATE_TRUNC('day', d.timestamputc),
        s.devicename
)

-- Combine all 3 granularities:
SELECT
    day AS period,
    'Daily' AS type,
    ROUND(SUM(cost)::numeric, 4) AS total_cost
FROM daily_costs
GROUP BY day

UNION ALL

SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('week', day) AS period,
    'Weekly' AS type,
    ROUND(SUM(cost)::numeric, 4) AS Reactive_Energy_Delivered
FROM daily_costs
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('week', day)

UNION ALL

SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', day) AS period,
    'Monthly' AS type,
    ROUND(SUM(cost)::numeric, 4) AS total_cost
FROM daily_costs
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', day)

ORDER BY period, type;
